mechanism: prolog-epilog (register scavenging) saves the status register around a scratch use in a loop block with a full-register read, PH killed $p, because C is genuinely live there; the flags N, Z and V are undefined on that path.
MOSCopyOpt recomputes block live-ins exactly; the whole-register read makes $nz (and $v) live-in to 15 blocks of main, back to a block whose JSR register mask clobbers N and Z.
MOSInsertREPSEP::preserveX, after that JSR, computes PLive from LivePhysRegs stepped backward from live-outs. $nz is in that set, so it emits PH $p without undef.
The machine verifier walks forward: no subregister of $p is defined after the call clobber, so it reports Using an undefined physical register at PH $p.
scope: The defect lies in preserveX (#321 prerequisite, also carried in 0002) deciding P liveness by backward liveness alone. Near-index proof recovery changes register allocation for this input so that the scavenger saves P before a preserveX point; recovery does not introduce the flag liveness itself.
